<plugin spec="beast.base.spec.evolution.sitemodel.SiteModel" id="SiteModel.s:$(n)" gammaCategoryCount="0"> <!--substModel will be automatically detected /--> <proportionInvariant id="proportionInvariant.s:$(n)" value="0.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="UnitInterval"/> <mutationRate id="mutationRate.s:$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="true" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal"/> <shape id="gammaShape.s:$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal"/> </plugin>
<distribution id="MutationRatePrior.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.LogNormal" param="@mutationRate.s:$(n)"> <M id="mutationRatePriorMean.s:$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> <S id="mutationRatePriorStdev.s:$(n)" value="1.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal"/> </distribution>

<distribution id="PropInvariantPrior.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.Uniform" param="@proportionInvariant.s:$(n)"> <lower id="PropInvariantPriorLower.s:$(n)" value="0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> <upper id="PropInvariantPriorUpper.s:$(n)" value="1" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> </distribution>
<operator id="proportionInvariantScaler.s:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.75" weight="1.0" parameter="@proportionInvariant.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator"/> <operator id="mutationRateScaler.s:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.75" weight="1.0" parameter="@mutationRate.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator"/> <operator id="gammaShapeScaler.s:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.75" weight="1.0" parameter="@gammaShape.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator"/>

<plugin id="KappaScaler.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator" scaleFactor="0.75" weight="1.0" parameter="@kappa.s:$(n)"/> <plugin id="FrequenciesExchanger.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.DeltaExchangeOperator" delta="0.2" weight="1.5" parameter="@freqParameter.s:$(n)"/>
<distribution id="KappaPrior.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.LogNormal" param="@kappa.s:$(n)" meanInRealSpace="false"> <parameter name="M" value="1.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> <parameter name="S" value="1.25" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal"/> </distribution>
<distribution id="FrequenciesPrior.s:$(n)" param="@freqParameter.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.Dirichlet"> <alpha spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealVectorParam" domain="PositiveReal" estimate="false">4.0 4.0 4.0 4.0</alpha> </distribution>

<distribution id="kappa1Prior.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.LogNormal" param="@kappa1.s:$(n)" meanInRealSpace="false"> <parameter name="M" value="1.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> <parameter name="S" value="1.25" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal"/> </distribution> <distribution id="kappa2Prior.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.LogNormal" param="@kappa2.s:$(n)" meanInRealSpace="false"> <parameter name="M" value="1.0" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real"/> <parameter name="S" value="1.25" estimate="false" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal"/> </distribution>
